opening.quote: I find problems that have not yet been articulated, translate them into the language of technology, and connect them to outcomes.
body: My work has spanned fintech AutoML, medical Computer Vision, e-commerce LLM Application, and generative AI video products. The outcomes have included team building, enterprise contracts, 10x MRR growth, and an official web product launch.

In a new domain, I start by mapping the product's infrastructure, system, and market. Then I use our product and competing products myself to find gaps that have not yet been defined. I bring issues tied to the core system to the organization as questions for the team to solve together. If a point of user friction can be tested independently, I prototype it myself. I keep working with the team until the effort produces a real outcome.

markets.intro: I have used all three languages to work directly on products and business across different markets.

items.detail: I speak Chinese at a native level and received Tsinghua University's best thesis award.
I work at a business professional level and have experience with global projects and international competitions.
I have basic business proficiency and have worked on products and business for Japanese enterprise clients.

body: I believe that the more concepts we can understand and define, the more problems we can solve. Learning new industries and technologies keeps expanding the breadth and depth of what I know. For me, that is both a way to grow and a condition for better outcomes.

I enjoy defining problems. AI helps me carry problems that might otherwise stop at the definition stage into experiments and solutions. I want to experience that same enjoyment, from definition through solution, with teams at more companies. That is why I keep doing this work.
motivation.belief: AI lets the joy of defining problems continue into the joy of solving them.

principles.title: I start by making the problem and success criteria clear.
principles.body: I map the product's infrastructure, system, and market, then translate C-level vision into KPI, OKR, and product success criteria. I also use our product and competing products myself to find gaps that have not yet been defined.

principles.title: I choose the validation method based on the problem.
principles.body: If a problem touches the core system, I turn it into a question the team can solve together. If the user friction can be tested on its own, I build the prototype myself. When a result does not support the hypothesis, I stop quickly and focus execution on work that has been validated.
